title: The J-2 property passes from an affine open cover to every affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ be an affine open covering. If every ring $\mathcal O_X(U_i)$ is J-2, then for every affine open $V\subseteq X$ the ring $\mathcal O_X(V)$ is J-2. Here J-2 is the ring predicate of [def-exc-excellent-ring]: the regular locus of every finite type algebra over the ring is open.

source.place: Tag 07R4 (lemma-J), implication (4) implies (3). The S in the printed covering formula in (4) denotes the scheme X of the lemma.
